# HTTP API reference

The self-hosted service (`queuetruth-service`) exposes `/v1`. This page is generated from `service/openapi.json`,
which the service exports (`make openapi`) and a test keeps current. The service also serves it at
`GET /v1/openapi.json`. To run the service, see [Self-host the service](../how-to/self-host-the-service.md).

## Conventions

- **Authentication.** `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, or HTTP Basic with the key as user name and an empty password.
  Keys have scopes `read`, `write` and `admin` (each includes the previous ones).
- **Idempotency.** Every POST accepts `Idempotency-Key`; endpoints marked "required" below reject a POST without it.
  The same key with the same body replays the stored response; the same key with a different body is 422
  (`idempotency-key-reused`); a request with the same key still in flight is 409 (`idempotency-in-flight`).
- **Errors** are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` documents (`qt.problem`): `type`, `title`, `status`,
  `detail`, `code`, `request_id`, and `errors[]` for validation errors. An unknown id and another tenant's id both
  give 404, never 403. Every response carries `X-Request-Id`.
- **Lists** take `?limit=` (1 to 200, default 50) and `&starting_after=<id>` and return `qt.page`
  (`data`, `has_more`, `next_cursor`).
- **Ids** are `<prefix>_<26-character ULID>`: `ten_`, `key_`, `up_`, `ds_`, `job_`, `rp_`, `zoo_`, `cal_`, `sc_`,
  `rpt_`, `del_`.
- **Times** in service documents are RFC 3339 UTC strings; inside analysis documents they are integer
  nanoseconds.
- **Specs** are the same objects as in the CLI and Python API, except that datasets and files are referenced by
  `dataset_id`, `upload_id` or `job_file`, and `out` must be null (the worker picks a private directory).
- **Rate limits** are per tenant (every key of a tenant draws on the same buckets); responses carry `RateLimit-Policy` and `RateLimit` headers (draft-based), and 429
  responses carry `Retry-After`.
- **Job flow.** Estimate (`POST /v1/<kind>/estimate`), submit (`POST /v1/<kind>`, 202 with `Location` of the job),
  poll `GET /v1/jobs/{id}`, list files (`GET /v1/jobs/{id}/files`, presigned URLs valid at most 15 minutes),
  download. The Python client (`queuetruth.client.Client`) and `queuetruth jobs ...` do this with automatic
  idempotency keys and sha256-verified, resumable downloads.

OpenAPI `3.1.0`, API version `0.1.0`.

## Endpoints

### `/v1/_store`

| Method | Path | Summary | Auth | Idempotency-Key | Request body | Success response | Status codes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/v1/_store/{key}` | Signed download (local store) | signed URL |  |  | binary | 200, 206, 403, 404, 409, 413, 416, 422, 500, 503 |
| PUT | `/v1/_store/{key}` | Signed part upload (local store) | signed URL |  | binary | Part stored; the ETag header carries its md5 | 200, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 500, 503 |

- `GET /v1/_store/{key}`: Downloads one object (`Range` supported). Parameters: `key` (path, required), `exp` (query, required), `sig` (query, required).
- `PUT /v1/_store/{key}`: Stores one part of a pending multipart upload. Parameters: `key` (path, required), `part` (query, required), `exp` (query, required), `sig` (query, required).

### `/v1/calibrations`

| Method | Path | Summary | Auth | Idempotency-Key | Request body | Success response | Status codes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/v1/calibrations` | List calibrations | API key |  |  | CalibrationRecordPage | 200, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |
| POST | `/v1/calibrations` | Submit a calibration | API key | required | CalibrationSpec | Submitted | 202, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |
| POST | `/v1/calibrations/estimate` | Estimate a calibration | API key |  | CalibrationSpec | Estimate | 200, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |
| GET | `/v1/calibrations/{calibration_id}` | Get a calibration | API key |  |  | CalibrationRecord | 200, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |

- `GET /v1/calibrations`: `qt.page` of `{id, spec, job_id, summary?}`. Parameters: `limit` (query), `starting_after` (query).
- `POST /v1/calibrations`: `{id, job}` + `Location`.
- `POST /v1/calibrations/estimate`: `qt.estimate`.
- `GET /v1/calibrations/{calibration_id}`: `{id, spec, job_id, summary?: qt.calibration_result}`. Parameters: `calibration_id` (path, required).

### `/v1/datasets`

| Method | Path | Summary | Auth | Idempotency-Key | Request body | Success response | Status codes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/v1/datasets` | List datasets | API key |  |  | DatasetPage | 200, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |
| POST | `/v1/datasets` | Register a dataset (validation job) | API key | required | DatasetCreate | Dataset | 202, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |
| GET | `/v1/datasets/{dataset_id}` | Get a dataset | API key |  |  | Dataset | 200, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |
| DELETE | `/v1/datasets/{dataset_id}` | Delete a dataset | API key | optional |  | Job | 202, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |

- `GET /v1/datasets`: `qt.page[qt.dataset]`, newest first. Parameters: `limit` (query), `starting_after` (query).
- `POST /v1/datasets`: `qt.dataset` (status `validating`) + `Location` of its `dataset_validate` job.
- `GET /v1/datasets/{dataset_id}`: `qt.dataset`. Parameters: `dataset_id` (path, required).
- `DELETE /v1/datasets/{dataset_id}`: `qt.job` of the deletion (objects hard-deleted, tombstone written). Parameters: `dataset_id` (path, required).

| GET | `/v1/health` | Service health (no auth) | none |  |  | Health | 200, 404, 409, 413, 422, 500, 503 |

### `/v1/jobs`

| Method | Path | Summary | Auth | Idempotency-Key | Request body | Success response | Status codes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/v1/jobs` | List jobs | API key |  |  | JobPage | 200, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |
| GET | `/v1/jobs/{job_id}` | Get a job | API key |  |  | Job | 200, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |
| POST | `/v1/jobs/{job_id}/cancel` | Cancel a job | API key | required |  | Job | 200, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |
| GET | `/v1/jobs/{job_id}/files` | List a job's files | API key |  |  | FileManifest | 200, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |
| GET | `/v1/jobs/{job_id}/files/{name}` | Download a job file | API key |  |  | binary | 200, 206, 302, 401, 403, 404, 409, 410, 413, 416, 422, 429, 500, 503 |

- `GET /v1/jobs`: `qt.page[qt.job]`, newest first, optionally filtered. Parameters: `limit` (query), `starting_after` (query), `kind` (query), `state` (query).
- `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}`: `qt.job`. Parameters: `job_id` (path, required).
- `POST /v1/jobs/{job_id}/cancel`: Queued jobs become `canceled`; running jobs get `cancel_requested` (the worker kills the child); 409 when the job is terminal. Parameters: `job_id` (path, required).
- `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}/files`: `qt.file_manifest` with presigned URLs (TTL <= 15 min). Parameters: `job_id` (path, required).
- `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}/files/{name}`: 302 to a presigned URL (S3) or the bytes with `Range` support (local store). Parameters: `job_id` (path, required), `name` (path, required).

| Method | Path | Summary | Auth | Idempotency-Key | Request body | Success response | Status codes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/v1/keys` | List API keys | API key |  |  | ApiKeyPage | 200, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |
| POST | `/v1/keys` | Create an API key | API key | required | KeyCreate | ApiKeyCreatedResponse | 201, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |
| DELETE | `/v1/keys/{key_id}` | Revoke an API key | API key |  |  | Successful Response | 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |

- `GET /v1/keys`: `qt.page[qt.api_key]`, newest first. Parameters: `limit` (query), `starting_after` (query).
- `POST /v1/keys`: `qt.api_key_created` (the secret appears only in this response).
- `DELETE /v1/keys/{key_id}`: Revocation is immediate; unknown or already revoked keys are 404. Parameters: `key_id` (path, required).

### `/v1/uploads`

| Method | Path | Summary | Auth | Idempotency-Key | Request body | Success response | Status codes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/v1/uploads` | Start a multipart upload | API key | required | UploadCreate | Upload | 201, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |
| GET | `/v1/uploads/{upload_id}` | Get an upload | API key |  |  | Upload | 200, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |
| DELETE | `/v1/uploads/{upload_id}` | Delete an upload | API key |  |  | Successful Response | 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |
| POST | `/v1/uploads/{upload_id}/complete` | Complete a multipart upload | API key | required | UploadComplete | Upload | 200, 401, 403, 404, 409, 413, 422, 429, 500, 503 |

- `POST /v1/uploads`: `qt.upload` with presigned part URLs (TTL <= 15 min; refresh with GET while pending).
- `GET /v1/uploads/{upload_id}`: `qt.upload` (fresh part URLs while pending). Parameters: `upload_id` (path, required).
- `DELETE /v1/uploads/{upload_id}`: Hard delete (objects and row) with a tombstone. Parameters: `upload_id` (path, required).
- `POST /v1/uploads/{upload_id}/complete`: Assembles the parts; status `complete` (sha256 verification follows asynchronously). Parameters: `upload_id` (path, required).

## Component schemas

Request and response bodies are defined in `components.schemas` of `service/openapi.json`. The analysis documents (`ReplaySummary`, `CalibrationResult`, `ScorecardSummary`, ...) are the same documents as in [Schemas](schemas.md).
